summary: The implementation satisfies the saved request-admission plan: v1/v2 workspace creation and callback registration are bounded with per-identity fixed-window admission, existing identical idempotency replays remain cheap while fresh keys are limited, 429 responses are structured with endpoint-specific reason codes and redacted limiter metadata, and the slice avoids auth, callback URL policy, and scheduler/capacity rewrites. Existing validation evidence records the requested focused pytest command, ruff, mypy, and OpenAPI drift check passing.
